# Internal linking audit

**Audited:** 2026-11-28 · **Generated by:** `npm run audit:links` (`scripts/seo/audit-internal-links.mjs --report`) · **Result:** ✅ all rules pass

## Scope and method

The audit parses every published article (Markdown guides and legacy TypeScript guides), the related-article module, the legacy commercial next steps, the commercial page routes and the 100-article plan. It checks link placement, counts, anchors, targets and reciprocity. It does not crawl the deployed site, measure rankings or replace Search Console link reports.

## Rules

| Rule | Threshold | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Every article links to related articles | ≥ 3 | ✅ 56/56 |
| Every article links to a commercial page | ≥ 1 | ✅ 56/56 |
| Markdown guides: contextual commercial links | 3–5 | ✅ |
| Markdown guides: commercial link above the fold | ≥ 1 | ✅ 20/20 |
| Markdown guides: supporting article links | 5–10 | ✅ |
| No anchor repeated inside an article | 0 repeats | ✅ |
| Exact commercial anchor sitewide (live + plan) | ≤ 4 uses | ✅ (live: 104 distinct anchors, max reuse 1) |
| Every commercial page receives links from multiple articles | ≥ 3 | ✅ |
| Every commercial page links back to related articles | ≥ 3 | ✅ |
| No orphan articles / broken internal links | 0 | ✅ |
| Planned articles meet the same rules | 100 articles | ✅ (min planned inbound: 3) |

These lists are computed from the content at build time, so they grow as new articles link in.
